Research information

About TickerLantern

Independent educational financial planning and investment research, with public source references, visible assumptions and interactive models.

TickerLantern is an independent educational research website. It brings together global index valuations, financial planning guides, company analysis, structured-note studies and equity-linked GIC research.

Read the evidence, then change the assumptions

Research pages link to public sources and identify observation dates where available. Interactive tools show how changing an assumption changes a result. A scenario is not a forecast, a guaranteed return or a personal recommendation.

Who writes the research?

Articles credited to TickerLantern Research are published under the website’s organizational byline. A byline does not imply an external professional designation, independent peer review or approval by a regulator.

Independence and scope

TickerLantern is not affiliated with or endorsed by the issuers and index providers discussed on this site. Product names and source references identify the subject of research. The site does not offer securities for sale or confirm trading availability.

Contact and corrections

Send a page URL and a description of the issue to support@tickerlantern.com. Please do not send account numbers, statements, identity documents or other private financial information.
